title: Personal Dashboard Freshness Guard
dataSources: Cross-stream correlations (`correlation:pair`), anomaly-day rollups (`anomalyday:score`), personal SLA checks (`personalsla:status`), and daily life scores (`lifescore:daily`).
app: Meta-monitoring for every `index=personal` stream, turning cross-signal correlations, anomaly-day scoring, and personal SLA dashboards into Splunk-native analytics.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=personalsla:status
| search freshness_ok="true"
| stats latest(_time) as last_seen count as events by dashboard_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| sort - hours_since
description: Shows which dashboardss have gone quiet for dashboard freshness checks.
value: A freshness guard keeps the meta-dashboard from telling a stale story about the rest of the system.
implementation: Send dashboard freshness checks events to `index=personal` and alert when the gap since the last event grows beyond the expected cadence.
visualization: Table of dashboardss with time since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It frames which dashboardss have gone quiet longer than they should for dashboard freshness checks.
